manifest.name: kq-imatrix-all-q4k
manifest.description: V2's map (every searchable tensor Q4_K: the fastest and smallest seed, decode 466 tok/s at 23.25 GiB, but RP-KL 0.1207 by kq_rtn) encoded by the contributed kq_imatrix instead of kq_rtn. The formats, and so the speed and memory, are V2's; only the rounding changes. kq_imatrix weighs every input channel by its mean x² on the pinned HPC-02 statistics (per expert for the routed experts), searches each sub-block's scale and minimum under those weights, refits the stored 6-bit and f16 scales, and rounds the shared experts, attention q/k/v and recurrent qkv/z by GPTQ on the pinned full x xᵀ. Measured on CPU on real Qwen3.6-35B-A3B tensors of layers 0, 3, 20, 38 and 39 (Q4_K, error relative to kq_rtn): routed experts 0.44-0.72 of the per-expert importance-weighted error on gate/up (unsloth's imatrix bytes: 0.46-0.75) and 0.22-0.74 on downs; output error tr(ΔW·XᵀX·ΔWᵀ) 0.28-0.34 on the recurrent qkv/z, 0.11-0.30 on attention q/k/v, 0.17-0.53 on the shared experts; tensors without statistics (attention o, recurrent out, embeddings, lm_head) get a uniform-weight fit, 0.80 of kq_rtn's squared error.
